subject: info-intr
title: (R)INFO.INTR.------TRS.
description: Chart on book p. 371 (NYM-5). INFO-INTR (information interpretation) is the subject, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of"; TRS (transition) is the partner. From the subject: PRI-INFO (principle information), MTA-IMP (meta-implications) and POL-DYM (political dynamics). From PRI-INFO: AFL-DY (affinity dynamics). From MTA-IMP: MTA-RT-SIGN (meta-reality significance). From POL-DYM: SOC-RT-P (social reality particular). From AFL-DY: INT (intention). From MTA-RT-SIGN: C-CONT (composite continuance). From SOC-RT-P: PROG-SIGN (progressional significance).
